slides.headline: TFSA or RRSP? Wrong answer costs you
Most students pick the wrong one because nobody explains it simply
TFSA: tax-free growth
slides.body: Put money in after tax. It grows and you never pay tax on gains

slides.headline: RRSP: tax refund now
slides.body: Deduct contributions from income. But you pay tax when you withdraw

slides.headline: Students: TFSA wins
slides.body: Your income is low now. RRSP deductions save you almost nothing
